text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC."}],"comment":"The heat treatment is specified but the stage at which it applies (before or after machining, before or after plating) is not stated. Without this, the manufacturer cannot sequence operations correctly, risking dimensional inaccuracy or coating damage. The designer should add a note clarifying when the toughening is to be performed relative to machining and surface treatment.","recommended_correction":"Update the heat treatment field or add a note specifying the manufacturing stage for the 24-32 HRC toughening (e.g., 'after rough machining, before final grinding and plating')."},{"rule_id":"TL-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D8","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 20"}],"comment":"The ⌀20 diameter on a part titled 'STOP PIN' is almost certainly the functional mating feature that locates or stops against another component, yet it carries no fit or tolerance callout and falls back to the general ±0.5 mm tolerance. This loose tolerance will result in unpredictable fit and unreliable stopping/locating function. The designer should assign an appropriate ISO fit or explicit tolerance band to D8.","recommended_correction":"Add a fit designation (e.g., ⌀20h7) or a specific tolerance to dimension D8 suitable for the pin's locating or stopping function."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D1","page":1,"quote":"25±0.1"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"Dimension D1 has a total tolerance band of 0.2 mm on a part that receives zinc plating (I.Z.B.P.), but the drawing does not indicate whether the plating thickness is included in or added to the 25±0.1 dimension. Plating buildup can push the finished size out of tolerance, causing assembly interference. The designer should clarify whether the dimension is before or after plating, or adjust the tolerance to accommodate the coating thickness.","recommended_correction":"Add a note stating whether D1 is a pre-plating or post-plating dimension, or reduce the nominal/tolerance to allow for the I.Z.B.P. coating thickness."}]}
